title: Mindless Rage
html:
Mindless Rage is a Berserker Barbarian passive feature. While raging, these barbarians cannot be Charmed or Frightened.

Description

Your rage becomes all-consuming, repelling outside influence.

While  Frenzied, you can't be  Charmed or  Frightened, and  Calm Emotions no longer ends your rage.

How to learn

Classes:

  • Class level 6: Berserker

Bugs

  • If Frenzied has not expended a turn, Mindless Rage does not always function. For example, while fighting the  Apostle of Myrkul, level 6 or higher Berserkers with 10 turns of rage remaining are still sometimes  Frightened after failing their save.[verify]
